properties.name: customClass
properties.description: Custom CSS class to apply to the outer div.

properties.name: visible
properties.description: Controls whether the bottom sheet is visible.

properties.name: displayMode
properties.description: Resting display mode: 'minimized', 'default', or 'expanded'. Drag/keyboard interactions do not overwrite this prop.

properties.name: dragStepThreshold
properties.description: Fraction (0-1) of the sheet height it must be dragged, in either direction, before it steps one level.

properties.name: header
properties.description: Configuration for the built-in header layout. Do not set this prop if you intend to use the 'header' slot.

events.name: sheetVisibilityChange
events.description: Event emitted when the visibility of the bottom sheet changes.

events.name: displayModeChange
events.description: Event emitted when the display mode changes, whether from a drag/keyboard interaction or from setting the `displayMode` prop. The new mode is in `detail.displayMode`.

events.name: headerBackClick
events.description: Event emitted when the header back button is clicked. Does not change sheet state.

events.name: headerCloseClick
events.description: Event emitted when the header dismiss button is clicked. The sheet is also closed automatically (`visible` is set to `false`).
